evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'If I may, I just need to ask some more questions about this move. Of course so we can provide you a more personalized estimate might take about ten to fifteen minutes if this is a good time.' — framing present but rushed past; no real wait for affirmation before diving into name/email collection.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Annie Carpenter), moving day (Sunday Oct 4), city-to-city (San Antonio to Austin), approximate size (one bedroom, 'seventh or eighth' — ~750-800 sq ft) — all four present.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'Do you have any special instructions for this move that you also want to discuss on this call?' — asked, but only after probing has already started (zip codes, addresses already collected).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'The main thing I'm having trouble is the driving. I don't have anybody to drive you also.' Joanna: 'Okay. I see no problem. That's fine.' — concern acknowledged with no follow-up or 'tell me more' probe; immediate pivot to next detail.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection or summary of concerns raised; concern simply acknowledged and moved past.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor (second), rooms (one bedroom, living room, kitchen/dining), walking distance (30-40 feet from stairs), additional rooms (none), special considerations (no couch, no washer/dryer, light dressers), additional stops (none — straight to Austin). All seven covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Joanna: 'Are you good with packing? You're planning to pack everything yourself or do you need help with that as well?' — offered as a yes/no question.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Joanna: 'Typically for one bedroom apartments we end up with about fifteen to 25 boxes in total. Do you think you would just follow within that range?' — asked with typical range provided.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna: 'Typically a one bedroom apartment usually takes two and a half to three and a half hours to move or complete... For the meantime, I can just quote you for the five to six hour mark... there's an estimated budget of $1,430 to including the transportation fee already.' — typical range + personalized to this move (two movers, $192/hr, $280 travel fee, Sunday rate, stairs at both ends).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna: '$96 per hour per mover... $192 per hour... includes the two men and the track... assembly, reassembly taxes, insurance, credit card fees, all of that is already in the price... one time travel fee of $280... two and a half hour minimum... only charge in fifteen minute interval.' — fees transparent, minimum and increment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Customer asks 'does the price end there?' and 'can you email me all that?' — Joanna responds to logistics questions but never pauses to ask if estimate feels fair or holds silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Joanna: 'On-time guarantee if we run late on the time we schedule, we provide discounts by the end of the day.' — discount framing present, though terms could be sharper ('by the end of the day' is vague vs. 'starts discounting immediately').
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Joanna: 'We will also include like our no worries, damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages. This already inclusive in the price.' — amount and 'included in price' stated, but no explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Joanna does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar. No explicit close to the Two Promises section; transitions directly to operational details (travel time, hour calculation).
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Never asked. Call moves directly from estimate to 'I'll send everything in the email' without a 'What's still concerning you?' or similar genuine check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' probe.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Customer volunteers 'can you email me all that?' and Joanna responds 'I'll go ahead and send everything in the email and if you're ready to go ahead with the booking just respond to the email or give us a call.' — no direct 'Would you like our help with your move?' ask; invitation contingent on email response.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No reference to rate-lock guarantee or deposit policy.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. No date, phone, arrival window, crew size, or address confirmation collected. Customer asked to respond to email; call ends without booking details confirmed.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details—property type, floor level, room count, access distance, stairs/elevators, parking, destination layout, box count expectations—which directly support accurate pricing and crew prep.
coaching_note: Section 7 was entirely skipped; rep never asked for the business explicitly and never collected booking details—customer left with 'respond to email' instead of a confirmed move date and crew information.
